period.label: latest complete ~3-month window the connector returned data for

queryDimensionNote: GSC's query-dimension report returned 658 distinct query rows summing to only 3 clicks and 6,016 impressions — far below the property-level totals above. This is expected: Google omits individual query rows below its privacy/anonymization threshold, so the query-level breakdown undercounts and must never be treated as the true total. Property-level totals (top of this file) are authoritative.

queryFindings.note: No query in the 658-row breakdown contains 'salaryexit' or 'salary exit'. Zero observable branded search demand in this window.

topZeroClickHighImpressionQueries.query: 12 lpa ka matlab kya hota hai
ctc to in hand salary calculator

queryFindings.classification: Every high-impression query observed is Definitional/informational ('what does X LPA mean', 'X lpa kitna hota hai') or a bare number-plus-unit lookup — none are Branded, and none show clear transactional/decision intent (e.g. 'salary calculator for my offer', 'compare job offers'). This matches the forensics report's prior finding that the site ranks for definitional queries, not decision-intent ones.

quickWins.finding: All 14 detected quick-wins are zero-click, position-4-to-10 rankings for Hindi-transliteration definitional queries ('X lpa ka matlab', 'X lpa kitna hota hai', 'X lpa meaning') on the two highest-impression LPA pages. Title/meta-description rewrites that directly answer 'what does X LPA mean per month' are the single highest-leverage, zero-cost SEO action available.

sitemap.reliabilityNote: GSC's list_sitemaps/get_sitemap 'indexed' count is a known-unreliable rollup field that frequently reads 0 regardless of true index status — contradicted here by real search-performance data across dozens of URLs. Not treated as evidence of a real indexing failure by itself.

flagshipReportIndexInspect.finding: Unlike the sitemap-level field above, this is a specific, reliable, page-level signal: Google has not indexed or even discovered the flagship report page. Combined with zero GA4 landing-page sessions for the same URL, the flagship report currently has no measurable organic presence at all.

linksReport.statement: GSC MCP does not expose external-link reporting.
